title.en: Wooden deck flooring on a terrace with fireplace

alt.tr: Gri taş kaplı şöminenin önünde, iki yanda odunluk bulunan teras zemininde bal rengi ahşap deck tahtaları
alt.en: Honey-brown wooden deck boards on a terrace floor in front of a gray stone fireplace with log holders on both sides

caption.tr: Gri taş kaplı şöminenin önüne döşediğimiz dar tahtalı ahşap deck. İki yanda tel kafesli odunluklar yer alıyor.
caption.en: Narrow-board wooden decking laid in front of a gray stone fireplace, with mesh log holders on both sides.
